newsitem.title: USA: Heartland Wireless issues $125 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Heartland Wireless issues $125 mln in debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from Heartland Wireless Communications Inc was priced in the private placement market late on Wednesday, according to a high-yield market source.
Proceeds from the deal will be used to expand Heartland's wireless cable system which operates primarily in rural areas, sources said.
BT Securities Corp was lead manager on the deal.
